disposition: Accepted after coordinator source and runtime verification. Reviews are static; only the coordinator ran the accepted runtime checks.
clarifications: Error statuses are enumerated per route;409 result/record accepts either declared RunStatus state as unavailable data.
Unsupported plan variation is refused locally. Submit reuses exact prepared bytes; no automatic retry follows a lost response or lookup404.
Upstream raw-text comparison and finished-without-result interleaving are not established by handler inspection.

The restart stand-in counts every repeated POST, but its replay/conflict branch is not exercised by that single-submit journey. Explicit byte-identical repeat is separately tested against the unit HTTP fixture.
Fixture persistence is not a product intent journal or upstream durability certificate.
